apexcn@oci.ssh_tunnel_command: REMOTE_DB_IP=$(ssh -i /path/to/source.key opc@203.0.113.11 "sudo docker inspect oracle-db --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}'") && [ -n "${REMOTE_DB_IP}" ] && ssh -f -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -i /path/to/source.key -L 15211:${REMOTE_DB_IP}:1521 opc@203.0.113.11

dev@oci.ssh_tunnel_command: REMOTE_DB_IP=$(ssh -i /path/to/dev.key opc@203.0.113.10 "sudo docker inspect oracle-db --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}'") && [ -n "${REMOTE_DB_IP}" ] && ssh -f -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -i /path/to/dev.key -L 1521:${REMOTE_DB_IP}:1521 opc@203.0.113.10
